name: sdk-v1.12.0
body:
### What's New

**TypeScript migration of SuperDoc.js** — The main public class now compiles as native TypeScript with full type annotations, eliminating 34 type-checking errors that surfaced under strict source checking.

**Public type exports** — `PermissionResolverParams`, `CanPerformPermissionParams`, `Document`, `SuperDocState`, and `AwarenessUser` now exported from the public facade. Developers no longer infer resolver callback shapes or use `Parameter` extraction.

**Word paragraph vanish fusing** — Paragraphs marked with `w:specVanish` now fuse forward to match Word rendering behavior. Numbered headings inline with body text, auto-numbering markers disappear, and counters advance per OOXML paragraph as Word implements it.

**Geometry methods on ui.metadata** — New `getRect({ id })` and `scrollIntoView({ id })` keyed on metadata id eliminate manual composition from separate content-control APIs.

### Fixes

**Cross-references and citations render in late-joined collaboration** — Clients joining an existing collaboration session now receive cached cross-reference and citation text properly hydrated from the Yjs fragment.

**List markers no longer vanish with paragraph-mark hidden** — The `w:vanish` attribute on paragraph-mark rPr was cascading into list markers. Now scoped to the paragraph mark glyph only; numbering-definition vanish still applies.

**Paragraph split no longer copies DOCX paragraph IDs** — Split-created paragraphs inherit unique IDs instead of duplicating the source paraId, preventing duplicate node identity after table separator splits.

**Fragment options preserved through setOptions before open** — Deferred `open()` no longer drops fragments set via `editor.setOptions({ fragment })` before the initial open call.

**Word hyperlink styling fully cleared on unlink** — Imported hyperlink underlines (including transient hyperlink style IDs) now properly clear when removing a link.

**RTL list navigation improved near markers** — List boundary arrow navigation corrected for right-to-left lists near marker boundaries.

**Editor.exportDocx return type corrected** — `exportDocx({ exportJsonOnly: true })` now properly types as `Promise<ConvertedXmlPart>` instead of `Promise<string>`.

**Config callback payload types aligned with runtime** — `onLocked`, `onEditorBeforeCreate`, `onEditorCreate`, `onCollaborationReady`, `onCommentsUpdate`, `onAwarenessUpdate`, `onListDefinitionsChange`, and `onReady` payload shapes now match what the runtime actually emits.

**Document API invoke<T> works for no-options operations** — Typed `invoke({ operationId })` no longer falls back to `unknown` for operations without an options parameter.

### Improvements

**TypeScript type safety across 700+ findings** — EventEmitter defaults, Whiteboard contracts, Toolbar fields, ProseMirror generics, CollaborationProvider callbacks, and SuperDoc event maps now have precise types instead of falling back to `any`.

**Internal Pinia stores hidden from public surface** — `superdocStore`, `commentsStore`, and `highContrastModeStore` no longer leak through TypeScript. Replaced by narrow public methods: `getPresentationEditorForDocument(documentId)` and `getComment(commentId)`.

**User type unified across packages** — SuperDoc no longer re-exports a separate User type. Unified to the super-editor symbol with color as an internal-only extension (`AwarenessUser`).

**Exception and content-error payloads reflect runtime** — `onContentError` now accepts `error: unknown` (not just Error) and `file: File | Blob | null | undefined`. `onException` now types the union of store-init, restore, and editor-lifecycle payloads.

**Metadata payload validation strengthened** — `metadata.resolve` now requires both anchor halves (SDT in body AND payload entry in customXml) to avoid false matches.

**Word-diff group anchoring corrected** — Pure-insert groups in tracked `text.rewrite` now anchor to preceding EQUAL tokens instead of previous group endpoint, fixing mangled output in sequences of inserts.

**VML watermark rendering improved** — Word-native watermark opacity and positioning now match Word's rendering across fixture matrices.

### Breaking Changes

name: v1.35.0
body:
### What's New

**Public API curation with three tiers** — Root exports now organized into supported (recommended path), legacy (backward-compat), and internal-candidate tiers. The public facade grows from 24 to 200 properly typed exports with clear JSDoc guidance on which APIs are recommended.

**Comment metadata sync from browser collaborators** — The CLI's headless bridge now receives browser-authored comment data (text, creatorName, creatorEmail, createdTime) via Y.Array, fixing a gap where `editor.doc.comments.list()` returned incomplete metadata for comments created in the web UI.

**Geometry methods on ui.metadata** — New `ui.metadata.getRect({ id })` and `ui.metadata.scrollIntoView({ id })` keyed on metadata id, eliminating the need to manually compose geometry from separate content-control APIs.

**Public track-changes helpers with concrete types** — `fieldAnnotationHelpers`, `markSnapshotHelpers`, `documentHelpers`, and remaining track-changes utilities now ship with JSDoc typedefs and emit real return shapes instead of `any`. Field names, element types, and signatures are now spelled out.

**Public contract tier metadata report** — New `pnpm report:public-contract` script audits the canonical config, verifies every `package.json#exports` subpath has a declared tier (supported/legacy/legacy-raw/asset), and warns on mismatches. Read-only in this phase; enforcement comes in phase 4.

### Improvements

**TypeScript type safety across 700+ findings** — Eliminated `any` leaks on EventEmitter defaults, Whiteboard data contracts, Toolbar fields, ProseMirror generics, CollaborationProvider callbacks, and SuperDoc event maps. Consumers now get precise IntelliSense instead of fallback-to-any for typed event subscriptions, toolbar item configuration, and device storage shapes.

**Internal Pinia stores hidden from public surface** — `superdocStore`, `commentsStore`, and `highContrastModeStore` no longer leak through TypeScript. Replaced by two narrow public methods: `getPresentationEditorForDocument(documentId)` and `getComment(commentId)` for backward-compatible reach without exposing internal state management.

**Narrowed host-bridge casting** — The toolbar host-contract cast consolidated from 4 scattered sites to 2 documented boundaries. Late-bound routing for custom commands preserved via `resolveFreshToolbarSources` helper.

**Metadata payload validation strengthened** — `metadata.resolve` now requires both halves of an anchor (SDT in body AND payload entry in customXml part) to avoid false matches against unrelated Word-authored content controls with overlapping tags.

**Link formatting fully cleared on unlink** — Imported DOCX hyperlink styling (including transient hyperlink style IDs and underline overrides) now properly clears when removing a link. Imported underlines marked `underlineType: 'none'` no longer incorrectly preserve the link underline.

**Word-diff group anchoring corrected** — Pure-insert groups in tracked `text.rewrite` now anchor to preceding EQUAL tokens instead of the previous group's endpoint, fixing mangled output when multiple insert groups appear in sequence (e.g., `[insert] of [insert`).

### Breaking Changes

**Editor.exportDocx({ exportJsonOnly: true }) return type** — Now returns `Promise<ConvertedXmlPart>` (the xml-js intermediate tree) instead of `Promise<string>`. Tests already walked the result as `result.elements[0]`; this corrects the type to match the runtime.

**HeadlessToolbarSuperdocHost changes** — `superdocStore?` field removed from the strict narrow host shape. `createHeadlessToolbar({ superdoc })` works with real SuperDoc (which provides narrow methods `getPresentationEditorForDocument` / `getComment`). Legacy inline host stubs with raw `superdocStore.documents[]` still compile via a deprecated union branch.

**ToolbarTarget.commands tightened** — Changed from `Record<string, (...args: any[]) => any>` to `Record<string, (...args: unknown[]) => unknown>`. Consumers passing custom commands need to narrow callback args before use; the escape hatch is now safer but not a free `any`.

name: sdk-v1.11.0
body:
Based on the commit log and changes, here are the release notes:

### What's New

**Type-safe event payloads** — SuperDoc emits ~24 fully typed events (editorCreate, commentsLoaded, formatting-marks-change, and others) with IntelliSense for event parameters. Whiteboard emits 5 typed events (tool, enabled, opacity, setData, change). IDE autocomplete now catches misspelled event names at compile time.

**Whiteboard data shape accuracy** — Stored whiteboard shapes now expose normalized fields with correct null variants (pointsN, widthN, heightN, stickerId). JSDoc fixed from stickers → images. Consumers now access the actual runtime structure.

**Metadata element geometry** — `ui.metadata.getRect({ id })` and `ui.metadata.scrollIntoView({ id })` expose positioning and scroll control for metadata-anchored content controls via the metadata id.

**Public contract tier metadata** — New `pnpm report:public-contract` command shows tier breakdown (supported, legacy, legacy-raw) and validates coverage for 200+ root exports.

### Fixes

**Envelope key handling** — CLI operations missing from response-envelope mappings no longer serialize under literal "undefined" keys. All 403 operations now have explicit envelope mappings with fail-closed guards.

**Comment metadata sync in headless mode** — `doc.comments.list()` now returns full metadata (text, creator name/email, timestamp) for browser-authored comments via Y.Array collaboration layer sync.

**Link cleanup on unlink** — Unlinking hyperlinks now scopes style removal to transient link styles only. User-authored formatting and imported inline underlines survive unlink. Negated underlines handled correctly.

**Request timeout forwarding** — SuperDocClient's `requestTimeoutMs` option now propagates correctly to headless bridge operations.

**Comment metadata resolution** — Resolution now requires both anchor mark AND matching payload entry. Foreign content controls no longer falsely resolve as metadata.

**URI decode safety** — Collaboration timeout diagnostics no longer throw on malformed percent-encoding; falls back to raw key.

### Improvements

**Tightened type signatures** — CollaborationProvider.on/off, Editor ProseMirror generics, extensions helpers, and converter/extensionService narrowed from any to concrete shapes. Removes all-purpose any catchalls on helpers; IntelliSense reflects actual contracts.

**Track changes helpers fully typed** — Last 4 helpers now carry concrete JSDoc returns: getLiveInlineMarksInRange, findTrackedMarkBetween, trackedTransaction, getTrackChanges.

**Internal stores hidden from public surface** — Vue mount handles (app, toolbar) and Pinia stores (superdocStore, commentsStore, highContrastModeStore) removed from emitted TypeScript interface. New narrow public methods replace direct store access.

### Breaking Changes

**TypeScript event type narrowing** — `superdoc.on('nonexistent-event', ...)` and `whiteboard.on('custom-event', ...)` are now compile errors. Event names are closed unions, not arbitrary strings. Runtime EventEmitter still accepts any string—only compile-time safety tightened.

**exportDocx JSON export type** — `Editor.exportDocx({ exportJsonOnly: true })` now correctly types as Promise<ConvertedXmlPart> instead of Promise<string>. Consumers calling JSON.parse on the result will need to update.

name: sdk-v1.10.1
body:
Based on my analysis of the code changes and commit messages, here are the release notes:

### Fixes

- **CLI collaboration diagnostics no longer throw on malformed percent-encoding** — Query parameters with raw `%` characters now fall back to raw key inspection instead of triggering `URIError`, keeping the entire timeout envelope intact for debugging.

- **Collaboration sync timeouts now include detailed provider diagnostics** — When synchronization times out, the error now includes last connection status, error events, event counts, sanitized URL, document ID, and authentication environment state. DNS failures, refused TCP connections, WebSocket upgrade failures, and authentication rejections are all captured. Sensitive query parameters are redacted.

**Metadata element geometry** — ui.metadata now exposes positioning and layout info for metadata-anchored content controls via `ui.metadata.getRect({ id })` and `ui.metadata.scrollIntoView({ id })`.

### Fixes

**Envelope key handling** — CLI operations missing from the response-envelope hint table are no longer silently wrapped under a literal "undefined" key. All 403 operations now have explicit envelope mappings with fail-closed guards.

**Comment metadata sync in headless mode** — Editor's `doc.comments.list()` now returns full metadata (text, creator name/email, timestamp) for browser-authored comments, not just anchor marks. Syncs from Y.Array collaboration layer.

**Whiteboard data shape accuracy** — Fixed incorrect JSDoc (stickers → images) and typed stored shapes distinctly from input shapes. Consumers now correctly access normalized fields like `page.strokes[0].pointsN` and `page.images[0].widthN` with proper null/undefined variants.

**Link cleanup on unlink** — Unlinking a hyperlink now properly scopes style removal to transient link styles only. User-authored formatting (Emphasis, etc.) and imported inline underlines now survive unlink. Handles negated underlines (`underlineType: 'none'`) correctly.

**Document API wording requirement** — Removed mandatory "alpha" and "subject to change" language from API overview checks. API is generally available; documentation framing now reflects product status without gate enforcement.

**Request timeout forwarding** — SuperDocClient's `requestTimeoutMs` option now correctly propagates to headless bridge operations.

**URI decode safety in diagnostics** — Collaboration timeout diagnostics no longer throw on malformed percent-encoding; falls back to raw key for sensitivity checks.

### Improvements

**Tightened type signatures** — CollaborationProvider.on/off, Editor ProseMirror generics, extensions helpers, and converter/extensionService surface narrowed from any to concrete shapes. IntelliSense now reflects actual API contracts.

**Track changes helpers fully typed** — Last 4 helpers (getLiveInlineMarksInRange, findTrackedMarkBetween, trackedTransaction, getTrackChanges) now have concrete JSDoc returns (PmMark[], TrackedMarkRange | null, Transaction, TrackedMarkRange[]). Removes hand-written .d.ts shims that shadowed real types.

**Internal stores hidden from public surface** — Vue mount handles (app, toolbar) and Pinia stores (superdocStore, commentsStore, highContrastModeStore) removed from emitted TypeScript interface. Narrower public methods (getPresentationEditorForDocument, getComment) replace direct store reach.

**Host-bridge type casting consolidated** — Eliminated scattered `as never` / `as unknown as` casts across UI layer in favor of one documented boundary helper. Type safety intent is now explicit at the call site.

**Comment resolution validation** — Metadata resolution now requires both anchor mark AND matching payload entry to succeed. Foreign content controls with matching tags no longer falsely resolve as metadata.

### Breaking Changes

**TypeScript-only event type narrowing** — superdoc.on('nonexistent-event', ...) and whiteboard.on('custom-event', ...) are now compile errors (event names are closed unions, not arbitrary strings). Runtime EventEmitter still accepts any string—this only tightens compile-time type safety to match actual emitted events.

name: v1.34.0
body:
### What's New

**Content Controls as first-class viewport entities** — Hit-test and retrieve rendered rects for SDTs without DOM attribute scraping. Enables custom UI overlays and smart field chips without duplicating position logic.

**ContentControls handle with React hook** — Read-only programmatic access to the active set, cached list, and individual control info. Mirrors the existing comments and tracked-changes surfaces.

**Metadata API for anchored payloads** — Document API operations on bookmarks, comments, tracked changes, and content controls now support anchored metadata: `attach`, `remove`, `update` with revision safety and dry-run preview.

**Custom XML parts CRUD** — Create, patch, remove, and list custom XML data storage parts through the Document API. Full OOXML package coordination with proper rels, properties, and content-type management. (Phase A; dry-run support tracked separately.)

**RTL table support** — Paragraph direction toolbar buttons (headless API). Visual direction context for tables with proper border/margin mirroring per ECMA-376. Logical cell-margin start/end mapping to physical padding.

**TOC toolbar item** — Add, update, and manage tables of contents from the editor UI. Respects schema constraints; sanitizes nested marks on rebuild.

**Format painter UX improvements** — Toolbar behavior now matches Microsoft Word: one-time mode by default, click state resets on use.

**Large image upload in headers/footers** — Image replacement and resizing now work in header/footer contexts, matching body editing capabilities.

### Improvements

**Metadata API error distinction preserved** — `metadata.attach` now correctly surfaces `TARGET_NOT_FOUND` for missing nodes and `INVALID_TARGET` for malformed shapes, instead of collapsing both to `INVALID_TARGET`. Clients that branch on error code for retry logic now get the right signal.

**Paragraph direction resolution per ECMA-376** — Paragraph inline direction now comes from the paragraph's own `w:bidi` property (or style cascade), not section bidi or run-count heuristics. Latin paragraphs in RTL sections now render left-aligned, matching Word.

**Table cell margins round-trip faithful** — Logical `w:start`/`w:end` attributes on cell margins now import and export correctly. Cell-level exceptions now properly override table-level defaults instead of silently dropping.

**Theme fonts preserved on round-trip** — Documents with `w:*Theme` rFont slots (per-script theme references) now round-trip without losing the theme linkage to font resolution. User font overrides correctly drop theme refs.

**Hyperlink marks survive tracked-change field splits** — Inserted hyperlinks that cross paragraph boundaries now export and re-import with the mark intact, instead of losing the link on the split portion.

**EMF+ and raw-pixel image rendering** — Embedded PNG/JPEG inside EMF+ payloads now render (extraction from GDI+ records). Raw-pixel EMF+ bitmaps decode and render as PNG with proper alpha handling.

**SVG image MIME types corrected** — Imported SVG images now export with correct content type instead of generic binary type.

**Search match visibility improved** — Matches now stay visible over source document highlight marks (run-level color) via `!important` CSS override. Find-and-navigation focus behavior corrected to keep focus on search input through repeated Enter/Shift+Enter.

**Comments and tracked changes round-trip together** — Comments anchored to tracked changes now resolve cascading when accepting/rejecting the TC, and properly thread as replies under the TC bubble on re-import (regardless of file origin).

**Numbered list definitions preserved** — Documents with tentative numbering (definitions not yet applied) now preserve those unused definitions on export instead of stripping them. Active numbering stays unchanged.

**Type safety hardened** — `EditorTransactionEvent.transaction` now typed as `Transaction` instead of `any`. `Config.onAwarenessUpdate.states` now properly typed as `AwarenessState[]`. Deep type audit strengthened via consumer matrix and package-shape verification.

**Default paragraph properties no longer injected** — `w:bCs`, `w:iCs`, and explicit `highlight=none` are no longer auto-generated on round-trip when absent from source, reducing export size and eliminating false-positive "intentional" toggles.

**Paragraph margin twips normalized on export** — Float-valued `w:pgMar` attributes (inherited from upstream pipelines) now export as integer twips per ECMA-376 §17.6.11, satisfying strict consumers.

**Explicit inline bidi preserved** — `w:bidiVisual w:val="0"` (explicit false for table visual direction) now exports correctly instead of being conflated with absent bidi, restoring the cascade-override semantics.

**RTL date rendering matches Word** — RTL date tokens now render with the same visual order Word produces (via per-run `dir` isolation and Unicode RLM markers around separators).

**Content control defaults standardized** — Newly created controls now default to `richText` type with explicit `w:richText` in SDTPR (matching Word) instead of the untyped `unknown`. Imported typeless Word controls properly resolve to `richText` per ECMA-376 §17.5.2.26.

**Content control mutations respect locking** — Programmatic updates to locked SDTs now use `AttrSteps` and inner-range writes instead of wrapper replacement, bypassing lock filters. Operations like `text.setValue` and `replaceContent` now succeed on `sdtLocked` controls as the spec permits.

**Paragraph indentation respects style cascade** — Increase/Decrease Indent now correctly read style-derived indent on cache miss instead of crashing before initial render.

### Fixes

**Slash menu dismissal restored** — Context menu now closes correctly on Backspace/Delete/Escape/ArrowLeft with proper slash reinsertion logic (slash-triggered opens only). Pressing `/` immediately after dismissal no longer inserts a literal slash. Menu headers and empty states now visible during filter.

**Toolbar dropdown keyboard focus** — Dropdown can reopen via Enter after Escape restores focus to the trigger button. Split buttons unaffected.

**Block SDT deletion** — Delete key now removes block-level content controls when cursor is at the first position (matching Backspace behavior).

**Mixed-bidi Backspace** — Backspace at mixed-direction boundaries now routes through the canonical command chain instead of bypassing undo grouping, history boundaries, and tracked-change wrapping setup.

**Hebrew/Arabic presentation forms recognized** — Strong-RTL character detection now includes Hebrew and Arabic presentation-form blocks (FB1D-FB4F, FB50-FDFF, FE70-FEFF), fixing mixed-bidi-backspace boundary detection for runs using legacy fonts.

**Native caret refinement gated** — Browser native-selection caret fallback now only applies to the local user's caret, not arbitrary positions queried by remote-cursor manager or arrow-nav binary search.

**Revision safety on metadata dry-run** — `metadata.attach` and `metadata.remove` now check `expectedRevision` before returning early on `dryRun: true`, catching stale revisions instead of falsely reporting success.

**Copy-slice metadata hidden** — Slice metadata on copied content no longer surfaces in pasted result.

**Hidden inline SDT visibility** — `w15:appearance="hidden"` SDTs now truly transparent: chrome suppressed, alias label omitted from DOM, text excluded from copy-paste and screen readers.

**SDT temporary property imported** — `w:temporary` flag now imports and surfaces through `ContentControlProperties.temporary` (previously always undefined even when source XML said true).

**Find input focus restored** — Pressing Enter in search input now re-focuses the input after navigation, allowing repeated Enter/Shift+Enter to advance through matches without focus stealing to the editor.

**Cross-page search scroll stabilized** — Match navigation now scrolls matches into view reliably by preventing focus-steal scroll conflicts, consuming selection-update flags, and re-asserting scroll position on the next frame to catch late displacement.

**Hebrew/Arabic presentation forms** — Presentation forms recognized as strong-RTL in mixed-bidi detection.

**Native selection caret** — Native caret refinement gated to local caret only; remote cursors and vertical-arrow probes no longer hijacked.

**Toolbar dropdown focus** — Dropdown focus restored on Escape, allowing Enter to reopen.

**Formatting marks button** — Now hidden by default and opt-in via `modules.toolbar.showFormattingMarksButton` config.

**Find input focus** — Find input focus restored after match navigation, allowing repeated Enter/Shift+Enter to advance.

**Bold/italic complex-script** — `boldCs`/`italicCs` no longer auto-propagated from bold/italic marks; only preserved when explicitly present.

**Numbering.xml round-trip** — Tentative numbering definitions preserved on export. Default numbering omitted on blank docs.

**Default run properties export** — bCs/iCs/highlight `w:val="none"` no longer injected on round-trip when absent in source.

**Themed run override** — User font changes on themed runs now respected; themed references no longer restored over user choice.

**Temporary flag import** — `<w:temporary/>` and `w:val` states parsed correctly; property surfaces in API.

**Cell margin key family** — Cell-level `w:tcMar` logical/physical key family preserved; no duplicate left/right from logical start/end.

**Table cell margin resolution** — Cell-level `w:tcMar` correctly overrides table-level `w:tblCellMar` per ECMA-376 precedence.

**Explicit bidiVisual false** — `w:bidiVisual w:val="0"` preserved on export, resolves to `visualDirection: 'ltr'` overriding style.

**Table borders/padding mirror** — Logical start/end stored as LTR-default physical; painter owns single visual mirror, eliminating double-mirror bugs.

**Table indent RTL** — Table indent anchors to right edge in RTL per spec.

**RTL alignment mirrors** — Paragraph alignment mirrors stored OOXML justification in RTL context.

**CommentReference rStyle** — Synthesized comment anchor runs emit canonical `<w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference"/>`.

**Track changes initialization race** — `getTrackChanges` now null-safe against pre-initialization state.

**Hyperlink field preservation** — Hyperlink fields split across boundaries preserve mark on constructed TC wrappers.

**Paste URL unlink** — Paste-added underline now tagged for removal on unlink; no stray formatting.

**TOC sanitizer recursion** — TOC sanitizer recurses into nested marks; `tocPageNumber` filtered regardless of depth.

**Text offset readback** — Position readback uses flattened offset model matching write side; `editor.doc.bookmarks.list()` offsets round-trip correctly.

name: esign-v2.7.1
body:
Based on the diff and commits, here are the release notes for v2.7.1:

### What's New

- **Metadata API** — `metadata.attach()`, `metadata.remove()`, and `metadata.get()` now available as a contract layer for anchored metadata operations.
- **Custom XML parts API** — Read, create, update, and delete custom XML parts via `customXml.parts.*` operations.
- **Native paragraph direction toolbar** — Toggle LTR/RTL direction on paragraphs directly from the editor.
- **Content controls as viewport entities** — Access and manipulate content controls through the document viewport API.
- **Formatting marks button** — Now configurable as opt-in via editor settings instead of always visible.

### Fixes

**Document Fidelity**
- Preserve `numbering.xml` definitions on DOCX round-trip.
- Preserve theme fonts (`rFonts`) when round-tripping documents.
- Preserve explicit `w:bidiVisual` values (`true` and `false`) on export.
- Preserve table cell margin (`w:tcMar`) logical/physical key family on round-trip.
- Preserve comment reference styles on comment anchor runs.
- Stop injecting default run properties and normalize paragraph margins to twips on round-trip.
- Import and lock appearance default contract for inline SDTs.

**Comments & Tracked Changes**
- Track change edits in document body now appear in the comments bubble.
- Keep comment range markers around unpaired tracked changes during edits.

**Direction & RTL**
- Honor inline `w:bidiVisual` only for table visual direction; respect table style settings otherwise.
- Recognize Hebrew and Arabic presentation forms as strong RTL text.
- Remove double-mirror transformation for logical cell margins in RTL tables.
- Preserve explicit `bidiVisual=false` in table direction resolution.
- Separate text direction detection from RTL hit testing logic.

**Content Controls**
- Mutate locked SDTs (structured document tags) via internal attribute steps and range writes.
- Default newly-created content controls to `richText` instead of `unknown`.

**Metadata API**
- Distinguish `TARGET_NOT_FOUND` from `INVALID_TARGET` error codes in `metadata.attach()` — clients branching on error types now receive the correct code.
- Throw `REVISION_MISMATCH` on metadata dry-run when expected revision doesn't match.
- Honor `expectedRevision` parameter on `metadata.attach()` and `metadata.remove()` dry-run.
- Align position readback with write-side offset model in document API.

**UI & Interaction**
- Restore find input focus after navigating matches in search.
- Restore toolbar dropdown keyboard focus after interaction.
- Gate native-selection caret refinement to local cursor positioning only.
- Recurse into nested marks when sanitizing table of contents.
- Add null-safe guard to `getTrackChanges()` to prevent initialization race crashes.
- Fix slash menu dismissal state logic.

**Type Safety**
- Align PDF config type in esign package — `pdfLib` now typed as `object` instead of `any`.

name: cli-v0.11.0
body:
### What's New

**Metadata API** — Anchor JSON payloads to text ranges with `editor.doc.metadata.attach()`, `list()`, `get()`, `update()`, `remove()`. Backed by hidden inline content controls and Custom XML storage.

**Custom XML storage operations** — Manage Custom XML Data Storage Parts with full CRUD: `editor.doc.customXml.parts.list()`, `get()`, `create()`, `patch()`, `remove()`. Round-trips through .docx export with complete package coordination.

**Content controls viewport integration** — Hit-test and anchor contextual UI to content controls. `ui.contentControls.getRect({ id })` returns painted bounds without DOM scraping.

**Paragraph direction commands** — Set paragraph direction with `editor.commands.setParagraphDirection({ direction })`. Alignment mirrors automatically in RTL. Headless toolbar via `controller.execute('direction-ltr'/'direction-rtl')`.

**Table of Contents toolbar button** — Insert and update TOCs from the UI with overflow menu and schema validation.

**Table RTL rendering** — Tables with `w:bidiVisual` now render cell order, borders (`tblBorders`/`tcBorders` start/end sides), and padding (`w:tcMar`) correctly. Arrow-key navigation respects visual direction.

**RTL mixed-bidi backspace** — Backspace at run boundaries between RTL and LTR text now produces correct direction markup.

**Format painter Word parity** — Format painter UX and state calculation now matches Microsoft Word behavior, including in headless mode.

### Improvements

**Type system precision** — Drained 26 instances of `any` from public API: `EditorTransactionEvent.transaction` now `Transaction`, `Config.onAwarenessUpdate.states` now `AwarenessState[]`, error causes now `unknown`.

**Direction context architecture** — Direction now resolves through typed per-axis contexts (paragraph, table, cell, section) per ECMA-376. Section bidi no longer forces paragraph direction; table bidi no longer affects cell paragraphs.

**Font theme preservation** — Run font theme references (`w:asciiTheme`, `w:hAnsiTheme`, etc.) survive user formatting and export round-trip correctly.

**Content control appearance** — Hidden content controls (`w15:appearance="hidden"`) render without visible chrome or alias text, enabling invisible anchors.

**Tracked change comment threading** — User comments anchored to tracked changes thread under the TC bubble on re-import. Accepting/rejecting a TC cascades to anchored comments.

**Table cell margin precedence** — Cell-level `w:tcMar` margins correctly override table defaults. Mixed logical/physical families resolve to physical LTR-default.

**Search match visibility** — Highlights now win over inline highlight marks via `!important`. Cross-page scrolling accounts for DOM and selection updates.

**EMF+ image rendering** — Images embedded in EMF+ payloads (Office charts, slides) extract and render via PNG/JPEG instead of placeholder. Raw pixel formats decode via canvas.

**Run metadata preservation** — TextRun now preserves run-level direction (`w:rtl`) and script (`w:cs`, `w:lang`) for future formatting stack decisions.

**Text direction hit-testing** — Hit-testing separates writing-mode (vertical/horizontal) from inline direction (RTL), fixing targets on vertical-text documents.

**Content control typing** — Typeless `w:sdt` elements resolve to `'richText'` per spec instead of `'unknown'`.

**Indent robustness** — Increase/Decrease Indent no longer crash on fresh paragraphs; style-derived indent honored on cache miss.

**RTL date rendering** — RTL-tagged date text injects directional marks so mixed-direction dates render in correct visual order.

**Slash menu UX** — Menu closes on Escape (re-inserts `/`), Backspace (removes `/`), allows immediate re-open without cooldown.

**Rich-text default** — New content controls default to `'richText'` with explicit `<w:richText/>` in markup.

### Fixes

- Metadata error codes properly distinguished (`TARGET_NOT_FOUND` vs `INVALID_TARGET`)
- Large image upload and resize now works in headers/footers
- SVG images import with correct MIME type
- Paragraph margin floats round to integers on export per ECMA-376
- Default run properties no longer injected on round-trip when absent in source
- Table diffing gates paragraph identity on depth, preventing cell↔body mispairing
- Table visual direction only forced by inline `w:bidiVisual`, not style cascade
- Comment range markers preserved as siblings to unpaired tracked changes
- Toolbar dropdown focus restored on Escape, allowing Enter to reopen
- Paragraph writing-mode now inherits from body section when omitted
- Locked content controls now mutable via document-api using attribute steps
- Hyperlink `w:rStyle="CommentReference"` preserved on anchor runs through round-trip
- Content-locked inline SDTs now selectable and deletable with single click/Delete
- Hebrew/Arabic presentation forms recognized as strong-RTL in mixed-bidi detection
- Native selection caret refinement gated to local caret only
- Metadata dry-run now throws `REVISION_MISMATCH` on stale revision instead of false-success

name: template-builder-v1.11.0
body:
Based on my exploration of the changes, here are the release notes for v1.11.0:

### What's New

- **Wrapper packages declare superdoc as direct dependency** — `@superdoc-dev/template-builder` and `@superdoc-dev/esign` now include SuperDoc as a regular dependency, not just a peer dependency. This ensures automatic installation of compatible versions when these wrappers serve as your SuperDoc entrypoint.

### Fixes

- **Toolbar serialization prevents unnecessary re-renders** — Inline toolbar configuration objects are now properly memoized, preventing SuperDoc from reinitializing on every parent component render.

name: v1.33.0
body:
### What's New

**Custom XML Data Storage Parts API** — Full read/write access to custom XML parts via `document.customXml.parts.list()`, `get()`, `create()`, `patch()`, and `remove()`. Supports filtering by namespace, schema references, and partName. Handles OOXML package coordination (storage parts, properties parts, relationships) automatically.

**EMF+ image extraction** — Render EMF+ images by extracting embedded bitmaps from EMF+ payloads. Supports compressed PNG/JPEG extraction and raw pixel formats (24/32-bit RGB/ARGB). Falls back to placeholder for vector-only EMF+ files.

**Images inside Word textboxes** — Inline drawings now render alongside text inside Word textbox content. Displays at baseline with proper alt-text support.

**Paragraph direction toolbar** — New headless toolbar entries `direction-ltr` and `direction-rtl` for programmatic paragraph direction control. Direction buttons can be added to custom toolbars via the headless toolbar API.

**TOC programmatic update** — Update table of contents entries via `editor.toc.update()` with options to refresh page numbers, rebuild entries, or change configuration (tab leaders, indentation).

### Fixes

**RTL/Logical direction preservation** — Paragraph `w:bidi`, table `w:bidiVisual`, and cell margins `w:tcMar` with logical `start/end` keys now preserve correctly on round-trip. Table visual direction (cell ordering) respects explicit `w:bidiVisual w:val="0"` overrides.

**RTL date rendering parity** — Date tokens inside RTL runs render in correct visual order matching Word (via directional isolation and RLM injection for separators).

**RTL paragraph alignment mirroring** — Left/right alignment on RTL paragraphs mirrors to stored OOXML justification (`left↔right`, `center` unchanged). LTR paragraphs unaffected.

**Tracked changes + comments round-trip** — Comments anchored to tracked changes now re-thread correctly on re-import. Cascade resolution of tracked-change acceptance resolves anchored user comments in one action. Reply nesting under TC bubbles preserved across save/reopen.

**Slash command menu dismissal** — Backspace/Delete now close the menu without inserting the slash. Escape closes and inserts the slash. Subsequent `/` immediately reopens the menu (no cooldown). Search header and empty state now visible while filtering.

**Content control mutations under lock** — Locked SDTs (`sdtLocked`) now accept programmatic mutations (`text.setValue`, `replaceContent`, `appendContent`, `setLockMode`) via attribute steps and inner-range writes. Lock mode (read-only, form-fill) still enforced by API guards.

**Toolbar dropdown keyboard focus** — Enter on a dropdown button now reopens the dropdown after Escape, and space/enter properly navigate inside the dropdown menu.

**Comment highlight specificity** — Search highlights and comment highlights no longer suppress each other. Lock-hover styling excluded from hidden content controls.

**Header/footer missing in collaboration** — Headers and footers no longer disappear when opening shared documents in collaboration mode.

**Finding cross-page matches** — Search results now reliably scroll into view on Enter/click. Focus restored to find input after navigation to prevent document mutations.

**SVG image import** — SVG images in imported DOCX files now render with correct MIME type.

**Numbered list preservation** — Numbering.xml definitions (both active and tentative lists) now round-trip unchanged. Blank documents no longer gain unused numbering definitions on export.

**Hyperlink preservation in tracked changes** — Hyperlinks inside tracked changes now survive export/re-import with proper marking. Pasted URLs get correct underline handling on unlink.

**Paragraph margin normalization** — `w:pgMar` attributes with float-valued twips round to integers on export per ECMA-376 `ST_TwipsMeasure`.

**Highlight marks on round-trip** — Complex-script (`w:bCs`), italic-complex-script (`w:iCs`), and highlight toggles no longer inject phantom elements on export when absent from source.

**Content control type defaults** — New content controls now default to `richText` (ECMA-376 compliant) instead of `unknown`. Imported typeless Word controls resolve to `richText` correctly.

**Run-level bidi/script metadata** — Text runs now preserve `w:rtl` flag and complex-script (`w:cs`) + language tag metadata for Wave 1b/1c rendering pipelines.

**Document API offset alignment** — Bookmark/citation offsets now match the flattened text model used for writes. Round-trip write-then-read returns the same offset.

**Package shape hardening** — Package exports now pass consumer typecheck matrix and package integrity audits. All public types verified free of tier-4-any exports.

### Improvements

**Viewport entity surface** — Content controls now expose hit-testing and rect-lookup on the viewport surface (same as comments and tracked changes). `getRect({ target: { type: 'contentControl', ... } })` returns painted rects without data-attribute scraping.

**Hidden content control appearance** — Content controls with `appearance:hidden` now render fully transparent. No padding, border, or hover state. Alias labels excluded from copy-paste and screen readers.

**Type precision on awareness** — Collaboration awareness state now types `AwarenessState` instead of `any[]`, exposing documented fields (`name`, `email`, `image`, `clientId`, `color`).

**Direction context resolver chain** — New `@superdoc/contracts` module centralizes paragraph/table/section/cell direction resolution with per-axis separation (inline vs visual vs writing mode). Eliminates spec violations where section RTL leaked to paragraphs.

**Table cell margin precedence** — Cell-level `w:tcMar` now correctly overrides table-level `w:tblCellMar` defaults in both LTR and RTL tables.

**Table border/margin logical sides** — Table borders and cell margins using logical `start/end` keys map to physical sides with RTL-aware fallback. Single visual mirror point (DomPainter) eliminates double-mirror bugs.

**Theme font preservation** — Paragraph runs with `w:*Theme` font slots (`w:asciiTheme`, `w:hAnsiTheme`, `w:cstheme`, `w:eastAsiaTheme`) now survive round-trip. User font overrides drop theme refs correctly.

**Comment reference styling** — Synthesized comment anchor runs now emit `w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference"` matching Word's canonical output.

**TOC rebuild on schema mismatch** — Table of contents updates now sanitize nested marks when the consumer schema omits `tocPageNumber`, preventing import failures.

**Indent command cache fallback** — Increase/Decrease Indent now compute on-miss instead of crashing when fired before rendering pass completes.

**Error type precision** — `ProofingError.cause` now types as `unknown` (correctly opaque). `EditorTransactionEvent.transaction` now types as ProseMirror `Transaction`.

**Internal object drag-and-drop** — Draggable handles on structured content blocks; rejects locked SDTs and foreign payloads.

name: react-v1.4.0
body:
### What's New

**Custom XML Data Storage Parts API** — Read, create, update, and delete custom XML parts programmatically via `document.customXml.parts.*` with automatic OOXML package coordination.

**EMF+ image rendering** — EMF+ images now render via embedded bitmap extraction instead of showing placeholders.

**Images in Word textboxes** — Inline images now display inside textbox content alongside text at baseline.

**Paragraph direction control** — Change paragraph direction (LTR/RTL) via `setParagraphDirection()` command and headless toolbar API.

**Programmatic table-of-contents updates** — Update TOC entries via `editor.toc.update()` to refresh page numbers, rebuild entries, or modify configuration.

**Content control viewport queries** — Query painted content-control locations via the same viewport `getRect()` API used for comments and tracked changes.

### Fixes

**RTL paragraph alignment** — Left/right alignment on RTL paragraphs now mirrors correctly to OOXML justification — matches Word behavior.

**RTL date rendering** — Date tokens inside RTL runs render in correct visual order via directional isolation and separator injection.

**Table cell margins in RTL** — Logical cell margins (start/end) map correctly to physical sides for RTL tables — eliminates double-mirroring.

**Tracked changes with comments** — Comments anchored to tracked changes now re-thread correctly on re-import with reply nesting preserved.

**Slash command menu dismissal** — Backspace/Delete close the menu without inserting; Escape closes and inserts the slash; filter state now visible.

**Locked content control mutations** — Locked SDTs (`sdtLocked`) now accept programmatic edits (`text.setValue()`, `replaceContent()`, etc.) via attribute steps.

**Toolbar dropdown keyboard navigation** — Enter on dropdown buttons now reopens the dropdown after Escape; space/enter navigate menus correctly.

**Cross-page search navigation** — Find results now reliably scroll into view; search input regains focus after navigation.

**Collaboration mode headers/footers** — Headers and footers no longer disappear when opening shared documents.

**Numbered list preservation** — Numbering.xml definitions (active and tentative) now round-trip unchanged.

**Hyperlinks in tracked changes** — Hyperlinks inside tracked changes survive export/re-import with proper marking.

**Theme font preservation** — Paragraph runs with theme-slot fonts (`asciiTheme`, `hAnsiTheme`, etc.) survive round-trip and resist user overrides.

**SVG image import** — SVG images in imported DOCX files render with correct MIME type.

**Paragraph margins** — Float-valued twips in `w:pgMar` normalize to integers on export per ECMA-376 spec.

**Comment reference styling** — Comment anchor runs emit canonical `w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference"`.

**Content control type defaults** — New content controls default to `richText` (ECMA-376 compliant) instead of `unknown`.

**Run-level metadata preservation** — Text runs preserve `w:rtl` flags and complex-script metadata for rendering pipelines.

**Document API offset alignment** — Bookmark and citation offsets match the flattened text model used for writes — round-trip consistency guaranteed.

**Type safety** — Public types verified free of tier-4-any exports; package passes consumer typecheck matrix and publint audits.

### Improvements

**Direction context resolver** — Centralized per-axis resolution for paragraph/table/section/cell direction — prevents section RTL leaking to paragraphs per spec.

**Table cell margin precedence** — Cell-level `w:tcMar` correctly overrides table-level defaults in both LTR and RTL tables.

**Hidden content controls** — Controls with `appearance:hidden` render fully transparent — no padding, border, or hover states.

**Viewport entity surface for content controls** — Content controls now expose hit-testing and rect-lookup like comments and tracked changes.

**Collaboration awareness types** — `AwarenessState` properly typed with documented fields (`name`, `email`, `image`, `clientId`, `color`).

**Editor event type precision** — `EditorTransactionEvent.transaction` types as ProseMirror `Transaction` for IDE IntelliSense.

**Comment highlight specificity** — Search highlights and comment highlights no longer suppress each other.

**Indent command resilience** — Increase/Decrease Indent compute on-miss instead of crashing before rendering pass completes.

**TOC schema compatibility** — TOC rebuild sanitizes nested marks when consumer schema omits `tocPageNumber`.

name: mcp-v0.5.0
body:
### What's New

**Custom XML Data Storage Parts** — Full read/write access to custom XML parts via document API. List, get, create, patch, and remove arbitrary XML alongside your document with GUID-based identity and schema reference support.

**EMF+ image rendering** — Render EMF+ graphics by extracting embedded bitmaps from EMF+ payloads. Handles PNG/JPEG extraction and raw pixel formats (24/32-bit RGB/ARGB). Vector-only EMF+ falls back to placeholder.

**Images in textboxes** — Inline drawings now render alongside text inside Word textbox content at baseline with alt-text support.

**Paragraph direction toolbar** — Headless toolbar entries for LTR/RTL paragraph direction control. Direction buttons can be added to custom toolbars via the headless toolbar API.

**TOC programmatic update** — Update table of contents entries via `editor.toc.update()` with options to refresh page numbers, rebuild entries, or change configuration (tab leaders, indentation).

**No-break hyphen (U+2011)** — Atomic inline leaf with backspace/forward-delete support and tracked-change preservation on export.

**Formatting marks toggle** — Render pilcrow (¶) for paragraph breaks with correct RTL positioning and indentation.

**Column balancing** — Multi-column sections balance left-heavy on ending page and split tables at row boundaries per ECMA-376.

**Page tokens in table cells** — PAGE/NUMPAGES fields inside table-wrapped headers/footers substitute per page instead of being cached.

**SDT-wrapped content** — Handle page-number fields and document parts wrapped in SDTs inside tables. Resolves nested SDT chains correctly.

**LLM table tools** — New `tables.applyPreset` for visual styling. `lists.delete` removes entire list sequences.

**New list marker styles** — 10 additional styles: square and circle bullets plus 7 ordered variants (upper-alpha-paren, decimal-paren, decimal-zero, etc.) with full OOXML round-trip.

**Content control viewport entities** — Hit-test and resolve rects for SDTs without data-attribute scraping. Viewport surface now includes content controls alongside comments and tracked changes.

**Internal object drag-and-drop** — Draggable handles on structured content blocks. Rejects locked SDTs and foreign payloads.

**Custom UI expansion** — New viewport methods `getHost()`, `positionAt()`, `contextAt()`. Selection methods `getRects()` and `getAnchorRect()`. Command methods `has()` and `require()`. Context-menu contribution API. Lifecycle helpers `restore()`, `createScope()`, `observe()`. Shortcut binding at registration.

**Run-level bidi and script metadata** — TextRun now carries optional bidi flag and script context (complex-script flag plus per-script language tags). Preservation-only in this release; rendering follows in Wave 1b/1c.

### Improvements

**Tab positioning for hanging indents** — Left-margin returns work correctly and extend to wrapped body lines. Right-aligned tabs no longer double-compensate.

**Column separator rendering** — Suppressed over empty columns, matching Word.

**Field preservation in tracked changes** — Detects and preserves w:del/w:ins wrappers on split fields.

**TOC in SDTs** — Recurses into custom-gallery children for instruction preference.

**Painter architecture** — DomPainter consumes only ResolvedLayout. Eliminated legacy paint(Layout) paths, paint-time DOM measurement, and dead fragment fallbacks.

**Presentation editor robustness** — Bails on inter-page gap clicks. Re-reads session state after header/footer exit. Preserves scroll on body click.

**Table operations** — Merge geometry preserved on cloned cells/rows. Identity attrs respect imported rsid family. `setCellText` NO_OP checks mark values. dryRun mirrors live behavior.

**Custom-selection right-click** — Respects disableContextMenu: true so browser context menus work.

**List context menus** — Right-click to continue/restart numbering inline. Changes apply to full list level including children.

**Paragraph direction context resolver** — ECMA-376-compliant direction chain covering section, table, cell, and paragraph contexts. Eliminates section-to-paragraph direction leakage.

**Table cell margin precedence** — Cell-level margins now correctly override table-level defaults per ECMA-376.

**Theme font preservation** — Paragraph runs with w:*Theme font slots now survive round-trip. User font overrides drop theme refs correctly.

**Comment reference styling** — Synthesized comment anchor runs now emit w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference" matching Word's canonical output.

**Aligned RTL alignment writing** — Left/right alignment on RTL paragraphs mirrors to stored OOXML justification (left↔right, center unchanged). LTR paragraphs unaffected.

### Fixes

**Section break ordering** — Tables, drawings, SDTs emit breaks before content, fixing 2-column tables rendering in wrong section.

**RTL export cascading** — Style-inherited w:rtl no longer force-pushed onto every run. CS companions survive docDefaults overrides.

**RTL paragraph alignment** — Left/right alignment mirrors to stored OOXML justification. LTR paragraphs unaffected.

**RTL date rendering** — Date tokens in RTL runs render in correct visual order via directional isolation and RLM injection.

**RTL direction preservation** — Paragraph w:bidi, table w:bidiVisual, cell margins with logical start/end preserve correctly. Explicit false overrides respected.

**Tracked changes + comments** — Comments anchored to TCs re-thread correctly on re-import. Cascade resolution resolves anchored comments in one action. Reply nesting preserved.

**Slash command menu** — Backspace/Delete close without inserting slash. Escape closes and inserts slash. Subsequent `/` reopens immediately. Search header and empty state now visible.

**Content control lock mutations** — Locked SDTs accept programmatic mutations via attribute steps and inner-range writes. Lock mode still enforced by API.

**Toolbar dropdown keyboard** — Enter reopens dropdown after Escape. Space/enter navigate inside menu correctly.

**Comment highlight specificity** — Search and comment highlights no longer suppress each other. Lock-hover excluded from hidden controls.

**Headers/footers in collaboration** — Headers and footers no longer disappear in shared documents collaboration mode.

**Cross-page search** — Results scroll into view reliably on Enter/click. Find input focus restored after navigation.

**SVG image import** — SVG images import with correct MIME type.

**Numbered list preservation** — numbering.xml definitions round-trip unchanged. Blank documents no longer gain unused numbering on export.

**Hyperlinks in tracked changes** — Hyperlinks inside w:ins/w:del survive export/re-import with proper marking. Pasted URLs get correct underline on unlink.

**Paragraph margin normalization** — w:pgMar float-valued twips round to integers on export per ECMA-376.

**Highlight mark injection** — Complex-script and italic-complex-script toggles no longer inject phantom elements when absent from source.

**Content control type defaults** — New controls default to richText per ECMA-376, not unknown. Imported typeless controls resolve to richText.

**Explicit bidiVisual false preservation** — w:bidiVisual w:val="0" (RTL override to LTR) now round-trips correctly.

**Theme rFonts round-trip** — Four-slot font references (ascii/asciiTheme, hAnsi/hAnsiTheme, eastAsia, cs/csTheme) preserve on export. User font overrides drop theme refs correctly.

**Custom XML export coordination** — Create/patch/remove coordinate OOXML package writes (Props Part, item rels, document-level rel, Content_Types.xml override). Tombstone collision prevention. Bibliography cache invalidation on part mutation.

**Content control type export** — All three types (richText, text, picture) now emit valid w:sdtPr elements on create and setType.

**Hyperlink ampersand escaping** — XML entities in OPC relationship attributes and Content_Types.xml properly escaped on export.

**Presentation editor session state** — Session re-reads cached paragraph properties after header/footer edit exit.

**Stale context-menu handles** — ContextMenuItem.invoke() refuses dispatch when entry is replaced by later register() call.

**Story-scoped selection restore** — capture/restore respects story boundaries. Returns 'stale' on mismatch instead of silent no-op.

**Type safety** — Drained implicit-any from EditorTransactionEvent.transaction (now Transaction), Config.onAwarenessUpdate.states (now AwarenessState[]), and ProofingError.cause (now unknown).

**Locked SDT mutations** — Operations like text.setValue, replaceContent, setLockMode on sdtLocked controls now work via AttrSteps and inner-range writes.

**Hidden inline SDT rendering** — appearance:hidden SDTs render fully transparent. No padding, border, hover state, or alias label leak into copy-paste or screen readers.

**Find bar search highlight visibility** — Search match highlight now wins over inline run background colors via !important.

**Images in textbox baseline alignment** — Inline drawings inside textboxes align to text baseline, matching body inline image behavior.

name: cli-v0.10.0
body:
### What's New

- **Custom XML Data Storage Parts** — Full document-api integration (list, get, create, patch, remove). Write and query arbitrary XML alongside your document with GUID-based identity and schema-ref support.
- **Content Control viewport entities** — Hit-test and resolve rects for SDTs without scraping data attributes. Viewport surface now includes content controls alongside comments and tracked changes.
- **Paragraph direction context resolver** — ECMA-376-compliant direction chain covering section, table, cell, and paragraph contexts. Fixes v1.31 bug where section w:bidi leaked to paragraphs; adds explicit undefined when no direction signal is present.
- **EMF+ image rendering** — Render EMF+ graphics via embedded bitmaps (MS-EMFPLUS § 2.3.5.1). Handles PNG/JPEG extraction, multi-record continuation, and raw-pixel formats (24bppRGB / 32bppARGB). Pure vector EMF+ falls back to placeholder.
- **SVG image support** — Fixed MIME type so inline SVG renders correctly.
- **Run-level bidi and script metadata** — TextRun now carries optional bidi.rtl flag and script context (complexScript flag + per-script language tags). Preservation-only in this release; rendering follows in Wave 1b/1c.

### Improvements

- **Slash command menu** — Search header shows "Searching: /<text>" while filtering. Empty state renders "No matching commands" when all items are filtered. Dismiss via Escape (leaves slash) or Backspace (removes it). No cooldown on reopening.
- **Find bar focus and scroll** — Restored focus to search input after Enter navigates matches. Fixed three scroll races (browser's scroll-element-into-view, #shouldScrollSelectionIntoView flag, RAF-deferred displacement). Cross-page matches now scroll reliably into view.
- **Table cell margin (tcMar) precedence** — Cell-level margins now correctly override table-level defaults per ECMA-376 §17.4.68. Resolves margin conflicts inside importer so downstream painters see single physical LTR-default shape.
- **Table RTL (bidiVisual) handling** — Visual cell ordering, logical border/margin mirroring, and RTL-aware resize. Table direction context flows through resolver. DomPainter owns single visual RTL mirror — no double-mirroring in pm-adapter.
- **Paragraph direction toolbar** — New headless toolbar commands `direction-ltr` / `direction-rtl` with alignment policy matching. (Not in default toolbar; wire via custom toolbar config or call `setParagraphDirection` directly.)
- **Numbering preservation** — Don't drop unused w:num definitions on export. Tentative and active numbering now round-trip fully. Skip numbering.xml only when source had none AND body contains no w:numPr refs.
- **Theme font family preservation** — w:*Theme rFonts no longer collapse to concrete names on round-trip. Cascade dedup extends to all four slots (ascii/asciiTheme, hAnsi/hAnsiTheme, eastAsia, cs/csTheme). User font override correctly drops theme refs.
- **Tracked change + comment interaction** — Comments anchored to TCs cascade-resolve when TC is accepted/rejected. Re-imported TC replies thread under their TC despite commentsExtended.xml presence. TC color preserved on anchored comments in All Markup mode.
- **Hyperlink preservation on split fields** — Fields split across paragraphs inside w:ins/w:del wrappers now preserve hyperlink mark on visible runs. Round-trip stable via SD-2858 preserve-raw path.
- **Locked SDT mutations** — Operations like `text.setValue`, `replaceContent`, `setLockMode` on sdtLocked controls now work via AttrSteps and inner-range writes. Wrapper-level transaction filter no longer silently blocks allowed edits.
- **Content control richText type** — Typeless SDTs resolve to 'richText' per ECMA-376 §17.5.2.26. Newly created controls default to richText instead of unknown; explicit <w:richText/> emitted on export.
- **Hidden inline SDT rendering** — appearance:hidden SDTs render with zero padding/border, no alias label, and no text leak into copy-paste or screen readers. Visibility correctly suppresses both lock-hover and viewing-mode hover styling.
- **Inline direction feature rename** — pm-adapter feature renamed from `rtl-paragraph/` to `inline-direction` to reflect two-axis governance (paragraph w:bidi + run w:rtl).

### Fixes

- **Toolbar dropdown keyboard navigation** — Pressing Enter on the restored focus after Escape now reopens dropdown. New `allowEnterPropagation` prop on ToolbarButton prevents double-firing plain buttons while letting dropdowns reopen. Space also opens dropdowns correctly.
- **Find bar search highlight visibility** — Search match highlight now wins over inline run background colors via `!important`. Yellow find color visible even on runs with explicit highlight marks.
- **Slash menu search display** — "Searching: /<filter>" header and "No matching commands" empty state now visible while filtering. Menu never collapses to zero height.
- **Slash menu right-click open** — Escape and ArrowLeft no longer insert `/` when menu opened via right-click. Track trigger (slash vs rightClick) and gate reinsertion accordingly.
- **Comment range marker placement** — Markers now stay as siblings of w:ins/w:del when no same-id wrapper follows to merge into. Prevents lopsided comment anchor structure on tracked changes.
- **Exported document size** — Stop injecting default w:bCs / w:iCs / w:highlight marks. Complex-script companions now only written when explicitly present on import. Exported markup matches source size.
- **Table cell margin export** — pgMar attributes now normalize to integer twips on export. Decimal-valued margins like `w:top="168.160400390625"` round to valid OOXML per ST_TwipsMeasure.
- **Explicit w:bidiVisual w:val="0" preservation** — Explicit false (RTL override to LTR) now round-trips correctly. Table visual direction resolver handles both true and explicit false cases symmetrically.
- **Direction axis separation** — Section w:bidi no longer cascades to paragraph base direction per ECMA §17.6.1. Table w:bidiVisual affects only cell order, not paragraph direction.
- **Collapsed inline run merger** — bidiCompatible guard prevents <w:rtl/> runs from merging with plain runs and losing the bidi flag.
- **Custom XML export coordination** — Create/patch/remove coordinate OOXML package writes (Props Part, item rels, document-level rel, [Content_Types].xml override). Tombstone collision prevention for remove → create sequences. Bibliography cache invalidation on part mutation.
- **Content control type export** — All three types (richText, text, picture) now emit valid w:sdtPr elements on create and setType.
- **Break ordering** — Section breaks on tables, drawings, and SDTs now emit before content per ECMA-376 ordering rules.
- **Hyperlink ampersand escaping** — XML entities in OPC relationship attributes and [Content_Types].xml properly escaped on export.
- **Presentation editor session state** — Session re-reads cached paragraph properties after header/footer edit exit, preventing stale resolved values.
- **Stale context-menu handles** — ContextMenuItem.invoke() refuses dispatch when entry is replaced by later register() call.
- **Story-scoped selection restore** — capture/restore respects story boundaries; returns 'stale' on mismatch instead of silent no-op.
- **Type safety** — Drained implicit-any from EditorTransactionEvent.transaction (now Transaction), Config.onAwarenessUpdate.states (now AwarenessState[]), and ProofingError.cause (now unknown).

### Deprecations & Removals

- **Paragraph direction buttons removed from default toolbar** — Reduced toolbar crowding. Available via headless `direction-ltr` / `direction-rtl` registry entries or direct `setParagraphDirection` command call.

**Document render stability** — Crash on certain layouts fixed.

**Tab spacing corrections** — Proper positioning for paragraphs with negative indents and hanging indents.

**XML export safety** — Entity escaping in OPC attribute values prevents export failures.

**Click handling** — No more errant editor activations from clicks between pages.

**Template Builder compatibility** — Bumped SuperDoc peer dependency floor to 1.31.1 to fix CSS selector generation in older versions.

body:
### What's New

**Right-to-left (RTL) document support** — Paragraph, section, table, and cell direction now resolve separately per ECMA-376, preventing margin collapse that renders Latin paragraphs right-aligned in RTL sections. Full support for body text, lists, headers, and footers with proper writing-mode inheritance.

**New list marker styles** — 10 new styles: square and circle bullets; upper-alpha-paren, decimal-paren, decimal-zero ordered lists; and upper-roman / lower-roman / lower-alpha / decimal ordered lists with customizable indentation.

**Drag-and-drop for internal objects** — Draggable handles on structured content blocks; smart rejection of locked SDTs, foreign payloads, and cross-editor drops.

**No-break hyphen support** — Import, export, and edit non-breaking hyphens (U+2011) with tracked-change preservation and proper backspace/forward-delete handling.

**Formatting marks toggle** — Visual pilcrow (¶) for paragraph breaks, with paragraph-margin positioning and RTL-aware rendering.

**Context menu for lists** — Right-click list items to continue/restart numbering inline without reopening properties.

**LLM tools for tables** — `tables.applyPreset` for visual styling and `lists.delete` to remove entire lists (all items in sequence).

**SDT-wrapped content in tables and structured blocks** — Renders page-number fields and other document parts wrapped in SDTs inside table cells; resolves nested SDT chains correctly per OOXML §17.5.2.

**Page tokens in table cells** — PAGE/NUMPAGES fields inside table-wrapped headers/footers now substitute per page (not cached).

**Column balancing** — Multi-column sections with continuous breaks balance left-heavy at section end, matching Word's pagination.

### Improvements

**Viewport and selection queries** — `ui.viewport.entityAt({ x, y })` for point-to-entity lookup; `ui.viewport.positionAt({ x, y })` for caret resolution; `ui.selection.getRects()` and `ui.selection.getAnchorRect(placement?)` for selection geometry without reading offscreen DOM.

**Context-aware menus** — `ui.viewport.contextAt({ x, y })` bundles point, entities, position, and selection state; `ContextMenuItem.invoke()` passes the full context to handlers.

**Story-scoped selection state** — `ui.selection.capture()` and `restore()` track active story (header/footer/footnote) so captures survive surface switches; `restore()` returns typed `'stale'` on story mismatch.

**Command registry helpers** — `BUILT_IN_COMMAND_IDS`, `ui.commands.has(id)`, and `ui.commands.require(id)` for startup validation; custom commands now refuse reserved proxy names.

**Shortcut fields on commands** — `ui.commands.register({ id, shortcut, execute })` with tightened parsing and dispatch.

**Scope lifecycle helper** — `ui.createScope()` collects subscriptions, custom-command registrations, and DOM listeners under one `scope.destroy()` call; cascades into `ui.destroy()`.

**Observe aliases** — Every domain handle (document, selection, toolbar, comments, trackChanges) now exposes `observe(snapshot => ...)` alongside `subscribe(({ snapshot }) => ...)` for uniform listener style.

**Tab positioning for complex indents** — Negative-left and hanging-indent paragraphs now seed implicit tab stops at the margin; default-tab segments justify against first-line width; painters preserve tab geometry across line wraps.

**Tracked-change preservation in fields** — Fields wrapped in `w:del`/`w:ins` now round-trip with tracking intact; unpaired field ends inside tracked-change elements emit raw nodes to preserve markup.

**Escaped XML in OPC rels** — Hyperlink targets and package metadata with ampersands no longer produce malformed `word/_rels/*.xml` on export.

**Type declarations for subpaths** — `converter`, `docx-zipper`, `file-zipper` subpaths now carry `types` fields; matrixd consumer typechecks cover all three (previously TS7016 on `skipLibCheck: false`).

**Painter architecture simplification** — DomPainter now consumes ResolvedLayout exclusively; sourceLayout, blocks/measures, setData/paint(Layout) removed from the API. Fragment back-pointers on resolved items eliminate parallel array lookup.

### Fixes

- Document render crashes on anchored content measurement.
- Context menu showing suggestions after type-check validation.
- Presentation editor respects `disableContextMenu` so right-click isn't suppressed globally.
- Clicks in inter-page gap no longer jump selection or scroll.
- Header/footer clicks after body editing now preserve scroll position.
- Story session state re-read after exiting H/F mode so body selection updates correctly.
- Column separators no longer draw over empty columns.
- Multi-page multi-column sections on body sectPr now balance only when multi-page (not single-page col-by-col).
- Mid-doc multi-page columns stay natural flow (don't rebalance like Word).
- TOC inside w:sdt now prefers child instruction over wrapper (respects per-TOC options like `\o`).
- Table column clone merges reset colspan and vMerge correctly.
- setCellText setShading now enforces required color parameter.
- setCellText dryRun mirrors live NO_OP behavior; extended identity attrs ignore rsid family.
- setColor and font operations inside setCellText now rewrite even when text-only appears unchanged.
- Row-clone hmerge preserves source cell shapes.
- Heading navigation dispatch now works headless (no active view required).
- RTL font-size (fontSizeCs), bold (bCs), italic (iCs) sync and export consistently; avoid mutation during export.
- Style-inherited RTL + docDefaults CS-companion overrides now preserve tracking and cascade correctly.
- Context-menu paste via right-click recognizes slice metadata from clipboard.
- SuperDoc `{{ User.email }}` now accepts `string | null | undefined` (was narrowed to string).
- `ExportParams.fieldsHighlightColor` now accepts `string | null` (runtime defaults to null when omitted).
- Provider fields widened to `CollaborationProvider` so Liveblocks-style adapters (disconnect/destroy optional) work; destroy() uses double optional-chain guard.
- `canPerformPermission` casts role and isInternal at call site.
- `Document.provider` allows providers without disconnect/destroy methods.
- `SelectionSlice.selectionTarget` JSDoc insert example corrected (value + type, not content).
- Selection resolve now uses canonical sdBlockId fallback (sdBlockId ?? id ?? blockId).
